en.headline: Central Kowloon Bypass to fully open on 6 December with $8 toll
en.dek: The Kowloon Bay section will open on Sunday 6 December, completing the bypass and Route 6, with a uniform $8 toll for all vehicles from the same day.
body: The government announced today that the Central Kowloon Bypass will be fully commissioned on 6 December 2026, with an $8 toll taking effect from the same date for all vehicles.

The Legislative Council approved the $8 arrangement last year. The Secretary for Transport and Logistics has made the relevant commencement notice, which will be gazetted on 16 October and tabled at LegCo for negative vetting on 21 October.

The bypass consists of the already open Yau Ma Tei section tunnel and the Kowloon Bay section scheduled for 6 December. Together with the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel, it forms Route 6, linking Tseung Kwan O, East Kowloon and West Kowloon.

A Transport and Logistics Bureau spokesperson said the toll, set after considering public affordability, is expected to recover part of operating costs while diverting traffic from major Kowloon roads. Busy-hour travel time between Tseung Kwan O and Yau Ma Tei is projected to fall from about 65 minutes to about 12 minutes.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道12月6日全線通車 收費8元
zh.dek: 九龍灣段將於12月6日通車，完成繞道及六號幹線，同日起所有車輛劃一收費8元。
body: 政府今日公布，中九龍繞道將於2026年12月6日全線通車，同日開始向所有車輛收取8元隧道費。
立法會去年已通過8元收費安排。運輸及物流局局長已訂立生效日期公告，公告將於10月16日刊憲，並於10月21日提交立法會先訂立後審議。
繞道包括已通車的油麻地段隧道，以及計劃於12月6日通車的九龍灣段。連同將軍澳—藍田隧道，組成六號幹線，連接將軍澳、九龍東及九龍西。
運輸及物流局發言人表示，收費在考慮公眾負擔能力後訂於8元，預期可收回部分營運成本，同時達到分流九龍主要道路交通的效果。預計繁忙時段往來將軍澳與油麻地的行車時間可由約65分鐘大幅減至約12分鐘。
